source_patch_targets.change: Add nil-by-default W09 trace sink field to fixture. In fixture.request, after request body encoding and ServeHTTP, opt-in sink writes actual method, path, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, raw request body, actual response status, response body and ETag with per-byte SHA256 and bytes; exclude Authorization/token. The sink must be enabled only by W09 tests and must record each request once, including 409/412. Do not infer results from expected status in fixture.expect.

New test-only helper: require an absolute fresh RESEARCHOS_W09_EVIDENCE_DIR under the runner-owned evidence root; create a unique directory per Go test name; fail the test if absent, reused, outside root, or any write/hash fails. Write each raw file once with exclusive create; emit manifest path, SHA256 and byte count. Snapshot actual local fixture bytes before t.TempDir cleanup, preserving root relative path, os.Lstat identity/type/mode, registered root ID, artifact content hash and capture time. Record absence after move/delete as observed absence, never as fabricated file bytes. Keep OBSERVED local snapshots distinct from SIMULATED opinions.
source_patch_targets.scope: test-only; export happens during Go test before temporary cleanup

source_patch_targets.change: Enable the trace sink in every selected W09 domain test. At C19-01..05 boundaries export the complete 27 EvidenceSupportSummary records (before and after primary modification), the exact two independent local snapshots, four repost snapshots, same-byte UNKNOWN copy, all 20 SIMULATED opinion IDs and their distinct kind/mode, origin edges, and chain before/after records. Export request/response and snapshot pins for each A06-01..03 and G02 test assertion. At each file/root transition record actual A/B canonical path, root identity/revision and authorization, file hash/bytes/mode or absent state, artifact/evidence validity, project/permission/content/index revisions, ContextBundle/Materialize result, search hit list/backend, FTS failure and bounded-scan response. The existing domain assertions and calls remain in place; export failures fail the native Go test.
source_patch_targets.scope: no change to asserted acceptance thresholds or evidence_kind

source_patch_targets.change: For each fresh run, pass RESEARCHOS_W09_EVIDENCE_DIR=<evidence>/owned to the Go child before test execution. After child completion require a new export manifest containing the exact selected-test set, all assertion IDs, unique test directories, raw member refs, SHA256 and byte counts. Rehash all members and record pins in the source report. Keep go-test stdout/stderr and report separately pinned. Refuse PASS on missing/foreign/drifted/incomplete export. Consume the locked absolute Git path for source version capture in the integration slice.
source_patch_targets.scope: does not itself issue formal PASS
